batches.scope: Bounded-stack cleanup for very wide RomFS rebuilds, with host regression
batches.ps5_result: Maintainer reported build looked good on PS5; targeted wide-RomFS/TOTK UltraCam reproduction not exercised.
batches.ps5_game_regression: User confirmed Metroid Prime 4 same 7–20 FPS fluctuations on Batch 01 checkpoint as on Batch 02a; specific cause not established, no full release qualification.

batches.scope: Batch 02a: bounded texture-cache scan counting evictions rather than skipped-image visits, with fallback flag gc_scan=upstream. Pool memory, PS5 Pro and 4/6/8 GiB layout remain 02b.
batches.ps5_observation: Metroid Prime 4: Beyond, previously roughly 50-60 FPS, now frequently 7-20 FPS and only briefly 50 FPS; Zelda Breath of the Wild initial area near 30 FPS with a momentary 24 FPS and no visible texture corruption. Exact cause unconfirmed. Do not promote Batch 02a; verify old checkpoint A/B under matching Vulkan, resolution, mods and settings. Follow-up confirmed same severe Prime 4 slowdown on Batch 01 without collector backport. Therefore do NOT attribute this issue specifically to Batch 02a.
batches.diagnostic_toggle: gc_scan=upstream is compiled only when EDEN_DEV_PROFILE=ON; normal release ZIP does not read it. Do not suggest editing dev-settings.txt to test it on a normal build.

upstream_evidence.symptoms: ~60 FPS at ~9 GB memory and 2–9 FPS near ~12 GB; occasional crashes
upstream_evidence.maintainer_observation: Official v1.003.000 exhibits similar Metroid Prime 4 slowdown in user test on 2026-10-16.
upstream_evidence.caveat: Latest upstream v1.003 also shows similar Prime 4 problem; upstream v1.002 included collector fix. Batch 01 without collector patch also reproduces FPS drop. Cause unconfirmed; next comparison pre-integration Switch UI build #37.

next_baseline.purpose: Separate original Switch UI foundation/runtime from Batch 01 RomFS backport and shared settings.
